note: RFC 7311 Section 3: 'Any other AIGP TLVs in the AIGP attribute MUST be passed along unchanged if the AIGP attribute is passed along.' Re-read all four tagged units. TestRFC7311OtherAIGPTLVsPassedAlongUnchanged compares the complete trailing second Type-1 and unknown Type-9 TLVs byte-for-byte at the final socket for unchanged next hop and next-hop-self, despite a policy replacement that drops them; it separately asserts first metric 100/130. TestRFC7311OtherAIGPTLVsSurviveTheCodec supplies conforming complete-byte roundtrip and first-TLV selection, supplemented by TestParseAIGPMultipleTLVs and TestAIGPWriteToMultipleTLVs. Valid lengths isolate preservation, not malformed-input rejection. Producers attribute.ParseAIGP/AIGP.WriteTo and reactor.applyFactsAIGP preserve all received bytes and modify only the first metric; fwdBatchHandler reaches Session.writeUpdateBody with AIGP enabled. Dropping, rewriting or accumulating the second metric would fail the exact assertions. The ownership fixture establishes admissible forwarded identity, not the RFC verdict; the socket octets establish the conditional whole obligation. Producer-halt records alone were not used as semantic proof.
